body:
版本 v0.32.2 发布，包含游戏底层架构迭代与前期核心系统打磨。

# World of ClaudeCraft（克劳德争霸） v0.32.2 Release Notes
**Release:** v0.32.2
**Date:** 2026-07-31
**Previous release:** v0.32.1
Version 0.32.2 is the second patch on the 0.32 line, and it is mostly about making rifts fair
and legible. The v0.32.1 rotation guaranteed one rift per zone per hour whether or not anyone
cleared the last one; respawn is now gated on the previous rift actually closing, and once you
are inside, a new HUD tracker finally tells you which floor you are on and how long the
entrance has left. Around the rift pair, party members appear on the zone and world maps,
escort ambushes can no longer be cheesed by outrunning them, a same-tick exchange of lethal
